projectDescription: ChimeEdu is an AI-powered interactive learning platform that enables K-12 teachers to create engaging classroom activities — including live quizzes, maps, timelines, flash cards, assessments, and study guides — and allows students to participate in those experiences from any device.
keyFeatures: Live multiplayer quizzes with join codes, leaderboards, and per-question timers
Interactive map activities with pinned locations and rich content cards
Chronological timeline activities with play mode for guided lessons
Spaced-repetition flash card decks with flip, type, and multiple-choice study modes
Fill-in-the-blank cloze activities with auto-grading and answer variants
Comprehensive assessments with auto-grading, submission tracking, and per-question analytics
Classroom hub linking all activities, assessments, study guides, and experiences
AI-assisted study guide drafting (Premium) powered by Claude
Google Drive integration for attaching institution files (Plus & Premium)
Experiences feature for structured field trips with travel mapping and student journals
Quick Activities — temporary activities with no account required
publicApiSurface: Teacher account registration and login (email/password, passkey)
Student account registration and classroom enrollment via join link
Guest quiz participation via 6-character join code (no account required)
Quick Activity creation without an account
Assessment submission and real-time results dashboard
Google Drive file/folder linking (Plus & Premium tiers)
Experience creation with travel mapping and student journal entries
Accessibility conformance report PDF export at /api/accessibility/export.pdf
